usedFor: Anchor handles invoices and proposals, and HubSpot tracks the sales, so “New Proposal Event” can start a deal through “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Proposal Event” in Anchor, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A proposal going out is where a deal begins, and the action opens that deal in HubSpot.

watchOut: “New Proposal Event” also fires on approved, expired or withdrawn proposals, so “Create Deal” can run several times for one proposal.
